value.rationale: This is a complete structural invariant of the open-world transition-warrant model: every source, every exact number of changed options, and every warrant grade are counted. The surprising source-preserving involution shows a robust equality of contradictory and unknown transition-warrant fibers. Exactly \(n+1\) of the \(4^n\) source states are universally possible, while unconditional possible-pair density decays as \(2(11/16)^n\). These exact quantitative constraints inform comparison or restriction of graded move systems, without asserting a result for arbitrary physical move relations.
